paraphrase: Omission controls for the three refutations of RIVAL-REFUTATIONS-ROUND2: for each premise of each refutation, a finite interpretation (one or two beings, one respect) keeps the other premises, fails that premise and satisfies the rival; and each refutation's premises hold together in a model with a nonempty per se link, a moved thing, or a uniformly moved body that has a mover. Logical models only, not metaphysical possibility claims.
